name: The Doll
source:
This disturbingly beautiful creation is an exact replica of Mordred Gaultier. Crafted by Huret, it looks almost lifelike enough to speak.

Despite its extraordinary workmanship, Julien sense there is something terribly wrong with it...

[From the [url=https://mordred-f.jimdo.com/]official site[/url]]
